name: 摇骰子
description: 双方各 5 颗 · 比较点数总和

llm.system_prompt: You are a strict dice-sum judge. Use only the supplied image. Reply with exactly one JSON object whose winner is LEFT, RIGHT, or TIE.
llm.user_prompt_template: Inspect the supplied stable frame and compare the two sides. Return {"winner":"LEFT|RIGHT|TIE"}.
llm.diagnosis_system_prompt: You are a strict visual inspection diagnostician. Do not declare a winner. Use only the supplied image and detector summary. Return exactly one JSON object with reason_code, message, and retry=true.
llm.diagnosis_user_prompt_template: The YOLO detector could not obtain a valid stable dice result. Detector summary: {detector_summary}. Explain the most likely reason, such as incomplete dice count, overlapping dice, occlusion, poor lighting, or unclear divider. Return {"reason_code":"INCOMPLETE_OBJECTS|OVERLAPPING_OBJECTS|LOW_LIGHT|OCCLUDED|NO_OBJECTS_DETECTED|UNSTABLE_DETECTION|SCENE_GEOMETRY_UNCLEAR|UNKNOWN","message":"...","retry":true}.

rules_intro.text: 欢迎来到摇骰子游戏。下面由我去宣读规则，当前双方各有五颗骰子，听语音提示开始摇骰子。屏幕的倒计时结束后就停止摇骰并且摆放到桌子上白色圆圈的区域，然后同时开盖，点数总和更大的一方获胜，如果明白了，请按绿色按钮开始游戏；如果需要再听一次，请按蓝色的按钮。

rules_confirmed.text: 准备好了吗，按下绿色按钮马上开始。

reveal_ready.text: 准备好了没有？三，二，一,开盖！

analysis_started.text: 正在调用视觉判断结果

analysis_retry_hint.text: 本次识别未完成，请整理好骰子后，可选择按蓝色按钮重新识别。

result_tie.text: 当前玩家点数{player_score}。Agent点数{agent_score}。本局平局，要不再来一局？

result_player_win.text: 当前玩家点数是{player_score}，Agent点数是{agent_score}。恭喜你，你赢了，你真的太棒了，快去找工作人员领取奖励吧。

result_agent_win.text: 当前玩家点数是{player_score}，Agent点数是{agent_score}。很遗憾，你输了哦，要不再来一局？
